name: camayoc_dora_time_to_restore
description: DORA time to restore (aegis-rb3): each failure streak of one service that began in the window, from its first failed or rolled-back deployment to the next succeeded deployment. restoredAt is the literal "open" while no succeeded deployment has followed. The reader takes restoredAt - firstFailedAt; Quipu SPARQL has no dateTime arithmetic. Reads camayoc window graphs only.
template: PREFIX aegis: <http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/> SELECT ?restoredAt (MIN(?at) AS ?firstFailedAt) (COUNT(?failure) AS ?failedAttempts) WHERE { { SELECT ?failure ?at (MIN(COALESCE(STR(?rat), "open")) AS ?restoredAt) WHERE { GRAPH ?g { ?failure a aegis:DeploymentEvent ; aegis:deployedService ?service ; aegis:deploymentOutcome ?outcome ; aegis:occurredAt ?at . } FILTER(STRSTARTS(STR(?g), "https://camayoc.local/window/") && ?outcome IN ("failed", "rolledback") && STR(?service) = CONCAT("http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/", "{service}") && STR(?at) >= "{start}" && STR(?at) < "{end}") OPTIONAL { GRAPH ?g2 { ?restore a aegis:DeploymentEvent ; aegis:deployedService ?service ; aegis:deploymentOutcome "succeeded" ; aegis:occurredAt ?rat . } FILTER(STRSTARTS(STR(?g2), "https://camayoc.local/window/") && STR(?rat) > STR(?at)) } } GROUP BY ?failure ?at } } GROUP BY ?restoredAt ORDER BY ?firstFailedAt

params.name: service
params.description: deployed service local name, e.g. quipu
